units.en: The eldest son Lin, style Shaoqing, was marshal of the grand commandant.
units.literal: The eldest son Lin, style name Shaoqing, was a marshal of the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 次子同卿，太子庶子，之才以其無學術，每嘆云雲：「終恐同《廣陵散》矣。」
units.en: The second son Tongqing was a household attendant of the heir apparent. Because Tongqing had no learning, Zhicai often sighed and said, "In the end I fear he will share the fate of the Guangling melody."
units.literal: The second son Tongqing was a household attendant of the heir apparent; Zhicai, because he had no learning, often sighed and said, "In the end I fear he will share the fate of the Guangling melody."

units.zh: 孝昌二年，至洛，勑居南館，禮遇甚優。
units.en: In the second year of Xiaochang he reached Luoyang; he was ordered to lodge in the Southern Lodge and received very generous treatment.
units.literal: In the second year of Xiaochang he reached Luoyang; he was ordered to lodge in the Southern Lodge and received very generous treatment.

units.zh: 天平中，齊神武徵赴晉陽，常在內館，禮遇稍厚。
units.en: In the Tianping era Gao Huan summoned him to Jinyang; he was constantly in the inner lodge and his treatment grew somewhat richer.
units.literal: In the Tianping era Gao Huan summoned him to Jinyang; he was constantly in the inner lodge and his treatment grew somewhat richer.

units.zh: 皇建二年，除西兗州刺史。
units.en: In the second year of Huangjian he was appointed inspector of Western Yan province.
units.literal: In Huangjian year 2 he was appointed Inspector of Western Yan province.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，武明太后又病。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning the empress dowager Wuming fell ill again.
units.literal: In spring of the second year of Daning, Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill again.

units.zh: 武平元年，重除尚書左僕射。
units.en: In the first year of Wuping he was again appointed left vice director of the imperial secretariat.
units.literal: In the first year of Wuping he was again appointed Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 楊愔以其南土之人，不堪典秘書，轉授金紫光祿大夫，以魏收代領之。
units.en: Yang Yin, because he was a man of the southern lands and unfit to direct the secretariat, transferred him to golden purple light grand master and had Wei Shou replace him in that office.
units.literal: Yang Yin, because he was a man of the southern lands and unfit to direct the secretariat, transferred him to golden purple light grand master and had Wei Shou replace him in that office.

units.zh: 之才獨云：「千人逐免，一人得之，諸人咸息。
units.en: Zhicai alone said, "A thousand men chase a hare; when one man gets it, all the rest cease.
units.literal: Zhicai alone said: "A thousand men chase a hare; when one man gets it, all the rest cease.

units.zh: 須定大業，何容翻欲學人。」
units.en: The great enterprise must be settled—how can you turn about and wish to learn from others?"
units.literal: The great enterprise must be settled—how can you turn about and wish to learn from others?"

units.zh: 又援引證據，備有條目，帝從之。
units.en: He also cited evidence, fully itemized; the emperor followed him.
units.literal: He also cited evidence, fully itemized; the emperor followed him.

units.zh: 見文宣政令轉嚴，求出，除趙州刺史，竟不獲述職，猶為弄臣。
units.en: When he saw Emperor Wenxuan's rule turning harsh he asked to leave the capital. He was made inspector of Zhao province but never took up the post and remained a court buffoon.
units.literal: Seeing Emperor Wenxuan's edicts grow ever stricter, he sought to leave office; he was appointed Inspector of Zhao province, yet never took up the post and remained a court jester.

units.zh: 未之官，武明皇太后不豫，之才療之，應手便愈，孝昭賜采帛千段、錦四百疋。
units.en: He had not yet gone to his post when Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill. Zhicai treated her and she recovered at once. Emperor Xiaozhao rewarded him with a thousand rolls of silk and four hundred bolts of brocade.
units.literal: Before he took office, Empress Dowager Wuming fell ill; Zhicai treated her and she recovered at once; Emperor Xiaozhao gave a thousand rolls of colored silk and four hundred bolts of brocade.

units.zh: 之才曰：「跂求伽，胡言去已。
units.en: Zhicai said, "Qiqiu Jia is Hu speech for already gone.
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Qiqiu Jia—in Hu speech, already gone.

units.zh: 至四月一日，后果崩。
units.en: On the first day of the fourth month the empress dowager died, just as he had said.
units.literal: On the first day of the fourth month the empress dowager indeed died.

units.zh: 之才云：「此色欲多，大虛所致。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This comes from excessive lust and great depletion of the vital principle."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "This comes from excessive lust and great depletion of the vital principle."

units.zh: 卽處湯方，服一劑，便覺稍遠，又服，還變成五色物，數劑湯，疾竟愈。
units.en: He immediately prepared a decoction. After one dose the vision drew farther away; after another it turned back into a five-colored thing; after several doses the illness was wholly cured.
units.literal: He immediately prepared a decoction; after one dose the vision drew somewhat farther off; after another dose it turned back into a five-colored thing; after several doses of the broth the illness was wholly cured.

units.zh: 年八十，卒。
units.en: He died at the age of eighty.
units.literal: He died at the age of eighty.

units.zh: 其不遜如此。
units.en: His insolence ran to such lengths.
units.literal: His insolence was like this.

units.zh: 其寬縱如此。
units.en: His indulgence ran to such lengths.
units.literal: His indulgence was like this.

units.zh: 之才醫術最高，偏被命召。
units.en: Zhicai's medical skill stood above all others, and he alone was repeatedly summoned by imperial order.
units.literal: Zhicai's medical skill was supreme, and he alone was repeatedly summoned by imperial order.

units.zh: 之才答曰：「蓋聞聖人虛其心而實其腹。」
units.en: Zhicai answered, "I have heard that the sage empties his mind and fills his belly."
units.literal: Zhicai answered: "I have heard that the sage empties his mind and fills his belly."

units.zh: 之才於和士開、陸令萱母子曲盡卑狎，二家苦疾，救護百端。
units.en: Toward He Shikai and Lu Lingxuan, mother and son, Zhicai was utterly obsequious and familiar; when the two households fell gravely ill he contrived a hundred ways to save them.
units.literal: Zhicai toward He Shikai and Lu Lingxuan mother and son was utterly obsequious and familiar; when the two households fell gravely ill he contrived a hundred ways to save them.

units.zh: 和士開知之，乃淫其妻。
units.en: He Shikai learned of this and violated his wife.
units.literal: He Shikai learned of this and violated his wife.

units.zh: 之才遇見而避之，退曰：「妨少年戲笑。」
units.en: Zhicai happened upon them and avoided them. He withdrew and said, "I am hindering the young man's sport."
units.literal: Zhicai happened upon them and avoided them; he withdrew and said, "I am hindering the young man's sport."

units.zh: 曾與從兄康造梁太子詹事汝南周舍宅聽《老子》。
units.en: Once he went with his elder cousin Kang to the house of Liang heir apparent's household chief Runan Zhou She to hear the Laozi.
units.literal: Once he went with his elder cousin Kang to the house of Liang heir apparent's household chief Runan Zhou She to hear the Laozi.

units.zh: 陳郡袁昂領丹陽尹，辟為主簿，人務事宜，皆被顧訪。
units.en: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.
units.literal: Chen commandery Yuan Ang held Danyang prefect; he recruited Zhicai as chief clerk, and whenever men had business affairs they were all referred to him for counsel.

units.zh: 郡廨遭火，之才起望，夜中不著衣，披紅服帕出房，映光為昂所見。
units.en: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.
units.literal: The prefectural offices suffered fire; Zhicai rose to look and in the night wore no clothes, but came out of the room in a red kerchief over his shoulders; the light caught him and Ang saw it.

units.zh: 豫章王綜出鎮江都，復除豫章王國左常侍，又轉綜鎮北主簿。
units.en: Prince of Yuzhang Zong went out to garrison Jiangdu; Zhicai was again made left regular attendant of the Yuzhang kingdom, then transferred to Zong's northern campaign chief clerk.
units.literal: Prince of Yuzhang Zong went out to garrison Jiangdu; Zhicai was again made left regular attendant of the Yuzhang kingdom, then transferred to Zong's northern campaign chief clerk.

units.zh: 及綜入魏，三軍散走，之才退至呂梁，橋斷路絕，遂為魏統軍石茂孫所止。
units.en: When Zong entered Wei the three armies scattered and fled; Zhicai retreated to Lüliang; the bridge was cut and the road gone, and he was stopped by Wei commanding general Shi Maosun.
units.literal: When Zong entered Wei the three armies scattered and fled; Zhicai retreated to Lüliang; the bridge was cut and the road gone, and he was stopped by Wei commanding general Shi Maosun.

units.zh: 詔徵之才。
units.en: An edict summoned Zhicai.
units.literal: An edict summoned Zhicai.

units.zh: 從祖謇子踐啟求之才還宅。
units.en: Cousin Zhan's son Jian memorialized asking that Zhicai return home.
units.literal: Cousin Zhan's son Jian memorialized asking that Zhicai return home.

units.zh: 之才甚怏怏不平。
units.en: Zhicai was very resentful and displeased.
units.literal: Zhicai was very resentful and displeased.

units.zh: 之才旣善醫術，雖有外授，頃卽徵還。
units.en: Because his medical skill was outstanding, though he was granted an outside post he was recalled within a short time.
units.literal: Zhicai being skilled in medicine, though given an external appointment, he was soon recalled.

units.zh: 之範出告之才曰：「童謠雲：『周裏跂求伽，豹祠嫁石婆，斬冢作媒人，唯得一量紫綖靴。』
units.en: Zhifan came out and told Zhicai, "A children's rhyme says: 'Within Zhou, Qiqiu Jia; at Leopard Shrine they wed Stone Granny; Cut-grave serves as matchmaker—you get only a measure of purple silk boots.'
units.literal: Zhifan came out and told Zhicai, "A children's rhyme runs: 'Within Zhou, Qiqiu Jia; at Leopard Shrine a bride for Stone Granny; Cut-grave as matchmaker—only a measure of purple silk boots.'

units.zh: 之才曰：「靴者革旁化，寧是久物？」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Boots: beside 'leather' stands 'transform.' How could that be something that lasts?"
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Boots—beside leather stands 'transform'; how could they be a lasting thing?"

units.zh: 之才曰：「蛤精疾也，由乘船入海，垂腳水中。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This is clam-spirit sickness, contracted by sailing the sea and dangling his feet in the water."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "It is clam-spirit sickness, from taking a boat to sea and letting his feet hang in the water."

units.zh: 之才為剖得蛤子二，大如榆莢。
units.en: Zhicai cut him open and took out two clam embryos, each as large as an elm pod.
units.literal: Zhicai cut him open and removed two clam embryos, each as large as an elm pod.

units.zh: 之才曰：「此人瘤也。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "This man has a tumor."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "This man has a tumor."

units.zh: 帝每發動，輒遣騎追之，針藥所加，應時必效，故頻有端執之舉。
units.en: Whenever the emperor's illness flared he sent riders to fetch Zhicai; needles and drugs applied on the spot always worked at once, so Zhicai was often kept in attendance at the bedside.
units.literal: Whenever the emperor's illness flared he would send horsemen in pursuit of Zhicai; needles and drugs applied at once always took effect, so there were frequent occasions when Zhicai stood in attendance at the bedside.

units.zh: 和士開欲依次轉進，以之才附籍兗州，卽是本屬，遂奏附除刺史，以胡長仁為左僕射，士開為右僕射。
units.en: He Shikai wished to advance in regular order. Because Zhicai's household register was attached to Yan province, which was his home jurisdiction, he memorialized that Zhicai be sent out as inspector there, with Hu Changren as left vice director and He Shikai as right vice director.
units.literal: He Shikai wished to advance in regular order; because Zhicai's household register was attached to Yan province, which was his native jurisdiction, he memorialized that Zhicai be additionally appointed inspector there, with Hu Changren as Left Vice Director and He Shikai as Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 及十月，帝又病動，語士開云：「恨用之才外任，使我辛苦。」
units.en: In the tenth month the emperor's illness flared again. He told He Shikai, "I regret sending Zhicai out to a provincial post—it has made me suffer."
units.literal: In the tenth month the emperor's illness flared again; he told He Shikai, "I regret sending Zhicai out on an external post—it has made me suffer."

units.zh: 其月八日，勑驛追之才。
units.en: On the eighth day of that month an edict went out by post relay to recall Zhicai.
units.literal: On the eighth day of that month an edict went out by post relay to recall Zhicai.

units.zh: 帝以十日崩，之才十一日方到。
units.en: The emperor died on the tenth; Zhicai did not arrive until the eleventh.
units.literal: The emperor died on the tenth; Zhicai did not arrive until the eleventh.

units.zh: 五年冬，後王徵之才。
units.en: In the winter of the fifth year the last ruler summoned Zhicai.
units.literal: In the winter of the fifth year the Last Ruler summoned Zhicai.

units.zh: 尋左僕射闕，之才曰：「自可復禹之績。」
units.en: Soon the left vice directorship fell vacant. Zhicai said, "Surely I can repeat Yu's achievement."
units.literal: Soon the left vice directorship fell vacant; Zhicai said, "I can surely repeat Yu's achievement."

units.zh: 祖珽執政，除之才侍中、太子太師。
units.en: When Zu Ting held power he appointed Zhicai attendant-in-ordinary and grand tutor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: When Zu Ting held power he appointed Zhicai Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 之才恨曰：「子野沙汰我。」
units.en: Zhicai said resentfully, "Ziye has winnowed me out."
units.literal: Zhicai said resentfully, "Ziye has winnowed me out."

units.zh: 珽目疾，故以師曠比之。
units.en: Ting suffered from an eye ailment, so Zhicai compared him to Music Master Kuang.
units.literal: Ting had an eye ailment, so he was compared to Music Master Kuang.

units.zh: 之才聰辨強識，有兼人之敏，尤好劇談謔語，公私言聚，多相嘲戲。
units.en: Zhicai was clever in debate and had a strong memory, with more than ordinary quickness. He especially loved witty talk and raillery; at public and private gatherings people often mocked one another in sport.
units.literal: Zhicai was clever in debate and had a strong memory, with more than ordinary quickness; he especially loved witty talk and raillery, and in public and private gatherings people often mocked one another in sport.

units.zh: 鄭道育常戲之才為師公。
units.en: Zheng Daoyu often jested that Zhicai was "Master-and-Duke."
units.literal: Zheng Daoyu often jested that Zhicai was Master-and-Duke.

units.zh: 之才曰：「旣為汝師，又為汝公，在三之義，頓居其兩。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Since I am your teacher and also your duke, among the Three Bonds I suddenly hold two of the roles."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Since I am your teacher and also your duke, in the Three Bonds I suddenly hold two of the roles."

units.zh: 盧元明因戲之才云：「卿姓是未入人，名是字之誤，『之』當為『乏』也。」
units.en: Lu Yuanming jested with Zhicai, "Your surname means not yet entered among men; your given name is a mistaken character, for zhi should be fa, lack."
units.literal: Lu Yuanming jested with Zhicai, "Your surname means not yet entered among men; your given name is a mistaken character, for zhi should be fa, lack."

units.zh: 之才卽應聲云：「為是宋鵲，為是韓盧，為逐李斯東走，為負帝女南徂。」
units.en: The others asked him to name them on sight. Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"
units.literal: The others tried to have him name them on sight; Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que, or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"

units.zh: 之才曰：「平平耳。」
units.en: Zhicai said, "So-so."
units.literal: Zhicai said, "So-so."

units.zh: 之才謂坐者曰：「箇人諱底？」
units.en: Zhicai said to those seated, "Whose taboo is it?"
units.literal: Zhicai said to those seated, "Whose taboo is it?"

units.zh: 之才曰：「生不為人所知，死不為人所諱，此何足問？」
units.en: Zhicai said, "Alive he was unknown to others; dead he is not tabooed to others—why is that worth asking?"
units.literal: Zhicai said, "Alive he was unknown to others; dead he is not tabooed to others—why should that be worth asking?"

units.zh: 之才蔑之。
units.en: Zhicai despised them.
units.literal: Zhicai despised them.

units.zh: 後以問之才，拜賀曰：「此是智牙，生智牙者聰明長壽。」
units.en: Later he asked Zhicai, who bowed in congratulation and said, "These are wisdom teeth; one who grows wisdom teeth is clever and long-lived."
units.literal: Later he asked Zhicai, who bowed in congratulation and said, "These are wisdom teeth; one who grows wisdom teeth is clever and long-lived."

units.zh: 弟之範，亦醫術見知，位太常卿，特聽襲之才爵西陽王。
units.en: His younger brother Zhifan was also known for medical skill. He reached minister of ceremonies and was specially permitted to inherit Zhicai's title as prince of Xiyang.
units.literal: The younger brother Zhifan was also known for medical skill; he reached Minister of Ceremonies and was specially permitted to inherit Zhicai's title as Prince of Xiyang.

units.zh: 裴讓之 弟諏之 讞之 皇甫和 李構 張宴之 陸卬 王松年 劉禕
units.en: Pei Rangzhi; younger brothers Souzhi and Yanzhi; Huangfu He; Li Gou; Zhang Yanzhi; Lu Ang; Wang Songnian; Liu Yi
units.literal: Pei Rangzhi; younger brothers Souzhi and Yanzhi; Huangfu He; Li Gou; Zhang Yanzhi; Lu Ang; Wang Songnian; Liu Yi

units.zh: 裴讓之，字士禮。
units.en: Pei Rangzhi, styled Shili.
units.literal: Pei Rangzhi, styled Shili.

units.zh: 魏天平中舉秀才，對策高第。
units.en: Under Wei in the Tianping era he was recommended as xiucai and ranked first in the policy examination.
units.literal: In Wei times under Tianping he was recommended as xiucai; in policy responses he ranked at the top.

units.zh: 累遷屯田主客郎中，省中語曰：「能賦詩，裴讓之。」
units.en: He rose to director of agriculture and master of guests in the masters of writing; at court they said, "Who can write poetry? Pei Rangzhi."
units.literal: He rose repeatedly to Director of Agriculture and Master of Guests in the Masters of Writing; within the ministry they said, "Who can compose poetry? Pei Rangzhi."

units.zh: 歷文襄大將軍主簿，兼中書舍人，後兼散騎常侍，聘梁。
units.en: He served as chief clerk on Gao Cheng's staff as grand general, then as concurrent secretariat attendant and later as regular attendant of the scattered cavalry on a mission to Liang.
units.literal: He served successively as chief clerk to Gao Cheng as grand general, concurrently secretariat attendant, later concurrently regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and as envoy to Liang.

units.zh: 帝欲以為黃門郎，或言其體重，不堪趨侍，乃除清河太守。
units.en: The emperor wished to appoint him yellow gate attendant, but some said he was too heavyset for palace attendance, so he was made grand administrator of Qinghe instead.
units.literal: The emperor wished to make him yellow gate attendant; some said his body was too heavy and he could not bear hurrying in attendance, so he was instead made grand administrator of Qinghe.

units.zh: 第二弟諏之奔關右，兄弟五人皆拘繫。
units.en: His second brother Souzhi fled to the western passes; all five brothers were imprisoned.
units.literal: His second younger brother Souzhi fled to Guanxi; all five brothers were detained.

units.zh: 讓之次弟諏之。
units.en: Rangzhi's next younger brother was Souzhi.
units.literal: Rangzhi's next younger brother was Souzhi.

units.zh: 齊受禪，靜帝遜居別宮，與諸臣別，讓之流涕歔欷。
units.en: When Qi took the throne, Emperor Jing retired to a side palace to bid the ministers farewell; Rangzhi wept aloud.
units.literal: When Qi received the mandate, Emperor Jing withdrew to a separate palace to take leave of the ministers; Rangzhi wept and sobbed.

units.zh: 事奏，竟賜死於家。
units.en: When the case was finalized, he was ordered to take his own life at home.
units.literal: When the matter was reported, in the end he was ordered to die at home.

units.zh: 為太原公開府記室。
units.en: He became recorder on the staff of the Prince of Taiyuan.
units.literal: He served as recorder for the Prince of Taiyuan's establishment.

units.zh: 梁使至，帝令讓之攝主客郎。
units.en: When a Liang envoy arrived, the emperor had Rangzhi serve as acting master of guests.
units.literal: When a Liang envoy arrived, the emperor had Rangzhi act as master of guests attendant.

units.zh: 與楊愔友善，相遇則清談竟日。
units.en: He was close to Yang Yin; whenever they met they talked the day away.
units.literal: He was friendly with Yang Yin; when they met they held pure talk the whole day.

units.zh: 答曰：「昔吳、蜀二國，諸葛兄弟各得遂心，況讓之老母在，君臣分定，失忠與孝，愚夫不為。
units.en: He answered, "Long ago Wu and Shu were two realms, yet the Zhuge brothers each got his way; all the more when Rangzhi's aged mother is here—lord and subject each have his place; to lose loyalty and filial piety together is what no fool would choose.
units.literal: He answered, "In former times Wu and Shu were two states, yet the Zhuge brothers each had his wish fulfilled; how much more when Rangzhi's old mother is here—ruler and minister roles are fixed; to lose both loyalty and filial piety is what a fool would not do.

units.zh: 伏願明公以誠信待物，若以不信處物，物亦安能自信？
units.en: I beg you, my lord, to meet the world with sincerity; if you meet the world without trust, how can the world trust you in return?
units.literal: I humbly wish the lord will treat things with sincerity and trust; if you treat things without trust, how can things in turn trust you?

units.zh: 以此定霸，猶卻行而求道耳。」
units.en: To found dominion on that is like walking backward to find the road."
units.literal: To settle hegemony on this basis is like walking backward to seek the Way."

units.zh: 神武善其言，兄弟俱釋。
units.en: Gao Huan approved his reply, and the brothers were all freed.
units.literal: Gao Huan approved his words, and the brothers were all released.

units.zh: 以參掌儀注，封寧都縣男。
units.en: For helping draft ritual regulations he was enfeoffed as baron of Ningdu county.
units.literal: For helping manage ritual regulations he was enfeoffed as Baron of Ningdu.

units.zh: 讓之以其亂法，殺之。
units.en: Rangzhi executed them for subverting the law.
units.literal: Rangzhi, because they had disrupted the law, killed them.

units.zh: 讓之少好學，有文俊辯，早得聲譽。
units.en: Rangzhi loved learning from youth; gifted in letters and sharp in debate, he won an early reputation.
units.literal: Rangzhi from youth loved learning, had literary talent, sharp eloquence, and early won reputation.

units.zh: 文襄嘗入朝，讓之導引，容儀蘊藉，文襄目之曰：「士禮佳舍人。」
units.en: Once when Gao Cheng went to court Rangzhi led him in with composed, refined bearing; Gao Cheng glanced at him and said, "Shili is a fine gentleman of the secretariat."
units.literal: Gao Cheng once entered court; Rangzhi guided him in; his bearing was composed and refined; Gao Cheng looked at him and said, "Shili is a fine attendant."

units.zh: 至郡未幾，楊愔謂讓之諸弟曰：「我與賢兄交款，企聞善政。
units.en: Soon after he took office in the commandery, Yang Yin told Rangzhi's brothers, "Your elder brother and I are close; I have been eager to hear of his good rule.
units.literal: Not long after he reached the commandery, Yang Yin said to Rangzhi's younger brothers, "Your worthy elder brother and I are close in friendship; I look forward to hearing of good government.

units.zh: 侍中高德政舊與讓之不協，案奏言：「當陛下受禪之時，讓之眷戀魏朝，嗚咽流涕，比為內官，情非所願。」
units.en: Palace attendant Gao Dezheng had long disliked Rangzhi; in his report he wrote, "When Your Majesty took the throne, Rangzhi clung to the Wei house and wept; service at court was not what he wished."
units.literal: Palace attendant Gao Dezheng had long been at odds with Rangzhi; in the memorial of investigation he said, "When Your Majesty received the mandate, Rangzhi cherished the Wei court, sobbed and wept; compared with being an inner-court official, his heart was not in it."

units.zh: 文宣大怒，謂愔曰：「欲得與裴讓之同冢耶！」
units.en: Gao Yang flew into a rage and said to Yin, "Do you want to lie in the same grave as Pei Rangzhi?"
units.literal: Gao Yang was greatly enraged and said to Yin, "Do you wish to share a tomb with Pei Rangzhi?"

units.zh: 讓之、諏之及皇甫和弟亮並知名於洛下，時人語曰：「諏勝於讓，和不如亮。」
units.en: Rangzhi, Souzhi, and Huangfu He's brother Liang were all famous in Luoyang; contemporaries said, "Souzhi outdoes Rangzhi; He cannot match Liang."
units.literal: Rangzhi, Souzhi, and Huangfu He's younger brother Liang were all famed in Luoyang; people of the time said, "Souzhi surpasses Rangzhi; He is not the equal of Liang."

units.zh: 于時霸圖草創，軍國務廣，文檄教令，皆自愔及崔㥄悛出。
units.en: At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Lingquan.
units.literal: At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Ling-Quan.

units.zh: 庚申，詔以故太師尉景、故太師竇泰、故太師太原王婁昭、故太宰章武王厙狄幹、故太尉段榮、故太師万俟普、故司徒蔡儁、故太師高乾、故司徒莫多婁貸文、故太保劉貴、故太保封祖裔、故廣州刺史王懷十二人配饗太祖廟庭，故太師清河王岳、故太宰安德王韓軌、故太宰扶風王可朱渾道元、故太師高昂、故大司馬劉豐、故太師万俟受洛干、故太尉慕容紹宗七人配饗世宗廟庭，故太尉河東王潘相樂、故司空薛脩義、故太傅破六韓常三人配饗顯祖廟庭。
units.en: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered twelve deceased ministers to receive associated sacrifice in the Founding Emperor's temple, including Wei Jing, Dou Tai, Lou Zhao, She Digan, Duan Rong, Wan Sipo, Cai Jun, Gao Gan, Moduo Lou Daiwen, Liu Gui, Feng Zuyi, and Wang Huai; seven others in Emperor Wenxiang's temple, including Princes Yue, Han Gui, and Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Liu Feng, Wan Sipo Shouluogan, and Murong Shaozong; and three more in Emperor Wenxuan's temple—Pan Xiangle, Xue Xiuyi, and Poliuhan Chang.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered that the late Grand Preceptor Wei Jing, Grand Preceptor Dou Tai, Grand Preceptor Prince of Taiyuan Lou Zhao, Grand Minister Prince of Zhangwu She Digan, Grand Commander Duan Rong, Grand Preceptor Wan Sipo, Minister of Education Cai Jun, Grand Preceptor Gao Gan, Minister of Education Moduo Lou Daiwen, Grand Guardian Liu Gui, Grand Guardian Feng Zuyi, and Inspector of Guang Province Wang Huai—twelve men in all—be given associated sacrifice in the Founding Emperor's temple court; that Grand Preceptor Prince of Qinghe Yue, Grand Minister Prince of Ande Han Gui, Grand Minister Prince of Fufeng Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Grand Preceptor Gao Ao, Grand Marshal Liu Feng, Grand Preceptor Wan Sipo Shouluogan, and Grand Commander Murong Shaozong—seven men—be given associated sacrifice in Emperor Wenxiang's temple court; and that Grand Commander Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangle, Minister of Works Xue Xiuyi, and Grand Tutor Poliuhan Chang—three men—be given associated sacrifice in Emperor Wenxuan's temple court.
